The '''Wampa's Vengeance''' was a ride that was located in [[Aucellis Park]], an entertainment park that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
